{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check premises
print("Severity levels:", df['severity'].unique())
print("Number of patients with SEVERE disease:", df[df['severity'] == 'severe'].shape[0])
print("Unique assay_batch values:", df['assay_batch'].unique())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check if patient_id is truly unique per patient
print("Number of unique patient_id:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total number of rows:", len(df))
print("Number of duplicate patient_id:", len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())"}
